nextRun.notes: Resume authenticated Instahyre, deeper Cutshort and YC pagination, then retry the 199 rate-limited LinkedIn Jobs checkpoints after cooldown before a new complete matrix. Continue fresh normal-post queries, blocked Internshala details, broad portals, employer ATS pages, missing-listing trails, and the full active-link audit.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry the 199 rate-limited query-location-page checkpoints from the 17-role-family by four-location matrix at starts 0, 25, and 50, then continue selected high-yield queries beyond start 50
sourceLanes.notes: The morning public LinkedIn Jobs matrix attempted all 204 role-family, location, and page combinations, but only five succeeded after the endpoint rate-limited 199 checkpoints with HTTP 429. Those failures are preserved for retry and the lane remains partial. Three fresh direct listings passed verification and were added through search fallback: Zebra Technologies Data Engineer.I (Power BI), Skydo Operations Associate, and Trelleborg Business Intelligence Specialist. Fresh FlixStock, Nutrabay Data Analyst, and MakeMyTrip candidates were rejected immediately before saving because their direct IDs redirected to expired LinkedIn searches. The active-link audit closed Grain Analytics and removed TravClan while its employer route returns HTTP 502.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn employee, recruiter, founder, and company posts were searched independently across four fresh query families using fresher, junior, intern, hiring, SQL, Python, Power BI, analytics, reporting, and target-city combinations. Discoverable candidates were one month or more old, edited older posts, or DM and email-gated posts without a fresh employer destination. No original post passed both the current-post and usable-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then canonicalize the newly added startup and LinkedIn roles where an exact employer requisition appears
sourceLanes.notes: The canonicalization pass searched exact employer destinations for Athelas, Cityfurnish, Enerjazz, Zebra, Skydo, Trelleborg, FlixStock, Nutrabay, and MakeMyTrip, plus fresh Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, and company-hosted queries. No exact canonical employer page displaced the six verified YC or LinkedIn routes. The FlixStock, Nutrabay Data Analyst, and MakeMyTrip IDs failed the final redirect gate and were excluded rather than published.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Authenticated Instahyre traversal, deeper Cutshort pagination, and current YC company boards, then recheck previously unavailable Wellfound IDs for state reversals
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first across YC, Cutshort, Wellfound, and Instahyre. Three previously missed live YC employer listings passed the direct Apply gate and were added: Cityfurnish Data Analytics AI Specialist, Athelas Data Operation Analyst, and Enerjazz MIS, Process Excellence and Automation Associate. Cutshort's current index surfaced only roles already represented on the board, while Instahyre and Wellfound remained inaccessible or generic. The lane remains partial for authenticated and deeper pagination.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, and specialist variants were searched independently. Internshala indexed Wadhwani Foundation, Propelld, and Groww candidates, but their direct destinations were inaccessible; August Assortments explicitly said the job was unavailable and was excluded. Unstop results had expired deadlines and Hirist results were old or senior. No specialist listing passed the direct-page gate.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Foundit, Naukri, Indeed, and broad-portal variants were searched for fresh early-career analytics roles in the target cities. Accessible results were generic search pages, stale indexed copies, client-rendered destinations, or duplicates without a stronger direct route. Foundit surfaced the same MakeMyTrip role, but neither a canonical employer requisition nor a live LinkedIn job destination could be verified. No broad-portal discovery passed the direct-page gate.
